newsitem.title: USA: UCAR to offer 5.8 mln shares at $38.
newsitem.headline: UCAR to offer 5.8 mln shares at $38.

text.p: UCAR International Inc said on Thursday it set a public offering of 5.8 million shares at $38 per share in simultaneous United States and international offerings.
All the shares are being sold by Blackstone Capital Partners II Merchant Banking Fund LP, Blackstone Offshore Capital Partners II LP and Blackstone Family Investment Partnership II LP.

The U.S. offering of 4.64 million shares also is being underwritten by Credit Suisse First Boston, Dillon Read & Co Inc, Goldman, Sachs & Co, Merrill Lynch & Co; PaineWebber Group Inc and the Nikko Securities Co International Inc.

The international offering of 1.16 million shares is also being lead-managed by Credit Suisse First Boston, Dillon, Read; Goldman Sachs International; Merrill Lynch International; PaineWebber International; and Nikko Europe PLC.
UCAR said it will repurchase 1.3 million shares from Blackstone upon the closing of the offering, as part of the company's previously announced stock repurchase program.
UCAR makes graphite and carbon electrodes.
